title: Extended writing under auto-scored gates
statement: Whether a course whose gates stay auto-scored should handle the outcome test's extended written response as rubric-feedback practice, audited model scoring or an ungated strand is unsettled.
detail: A grade-7 reading course's BrainLift leaves this open: an extended constructed response crosses the auto-scoring boundary its gates are locked on. If the state test that includes one becomes the reported anchor, it lists three options: practice only, with rubric feedback and the gates unchanged; model-scored responses with human-audited calibration; or a separate ungated strand reported alongside. It records that the fork is real and no option is selected, pending that test's blueprint and scoring rules.
